name: Depressants
line: Slow the central nervous system: alcohol, benzodiazepines, GHB. Share the risk of respiratory depression when combined.

name: Stimulants
line: Raise dopamine and noradrenaline signalling: caffeine, nicotine, cocaine, the amphetamines, cathinones.

name: Entactogens
line: Serotonin-releasing drugs with pro-social effects: MDMA and relatives.

name: Classic psychedelics
line: 5-HT2A receptor agonists: LSD, psilocybin, DMT, mescaline, the 2C series.

name: Atypical psychedelics
line: Psychedelic-like effects by other mechanisms: salvia (κ-opioid).

name: Dissociatives
line: NMDA receptor antagonists: ketamine, PCP, DXM, nitrous oxide.

name: Cannabinoids
line: CB1 receptor agonists: cannabis and the synthetic full agonists.

name: Opioids
line: μ-opioid receptor agonists: heroin, fentanyls, prescription opioids, methadone, buprenorphine, kratom.

name: Inhalants
line: Volatile substances: alkyl nitrites, solvents, gases.
